plan.question: Do the earliest between-execution gradient-checksum discrepancies in the complete-row magnitude intervention reflect an unstable checksum observer, unequal unobserved state, or actual variation in backward computation/accumulation? Verified identical-source, declared-seed42 schema2 magnitude runs have validation AUCs 0.6149316420253298, 0.6150866723308610 and 0.6148001666752104; all have lower AUC and higher Logloss than the three none controls, whose AUC repeats at 0.6151021885074872. The latest magnitude pair differs in both gradient checksums at call0 despite matching recorded input, parameter and logit checksums; their within-run repeated-gradient checks pass. Their parameter/logit checksums still match at call1 and differ at call512, so the exact first update divergence is unknown. The historical round17 magnitude AUC advantage of 0.0001774051692154 is smaller than the schema2 same-seed AUC range of 0.0002865056556506; preserve separate source strata and the original adverse Logloss contrast. Retrieve evidence that can discriminate observer stability and exact common-state equality before localizing pre-intervention gradients, row scales, accumulated gradients or Adam updates. These candidate-owned sketches establish a repeatability limitation, not a hardware cause, tensor distance, semantic mechanism benefit or independent-seed result.
missing_information: The complete scoped memory memory://agent-r0023 was resolved and reviewed, including alternatives, superseded claims, failed branches and latest declared knowledge usage. The local paper search for reproducibility/nondeterminism/gradient-accumulation/checksum evidence returned no matches; this is a retrieval limitation, not evidence that relevant prior work does not exist. No novelty claim is established.

Candidate and schema2 observer source are absent in this phase. Need the exact checksum implementation, tensor coverage, dtype/stride/serialization handling and a fixed-tensor stability control: repeatedly sketch an unchanged tensor and compare actual values or canonical bytes without intervening forward/backward work. Retain the original sketch definition as a versioned bridge. Differing sketches with equal actual tensors would invalidate the tensor-divergence interpretation.

Need the strongest authorized comparison of actual initial inputs, labels, parameters, model buffers, RNG and optimizer state. Matching sketches and within-run gates cannot certify cross-execution common state. If required state is unavailable or unequal, retain only the whole-execution repeatability finding and stop operator-specific attribution.

Conditional on observer stability and verified common state, need bounded call0/1 actual-value comparisons of pre-intervention complete gradient G, projected target P, eligibility masks, guarded row scales, transformed gradient, accumulated gradient and actual Adam parameter update. Record absolute/relative errors and predefined tolerances; checksum mismatch gives no numerical distance. Identical raw-gradient direction does not establish identical Adam-step direction.

Need controls that distinguish observer effects from intervention-associated execution variation: unchanged-tensor observer checks, common-state repeated backward checks, the corresponding none control and a versioned parent bridge. A full-path observer-effect claim would require a prospective repeated observer-on/off by intervention factorial; historical single on/off differences are insufficient. Preserve frozen data, scoring, precision/determinism, optimizer recipe and checkpoint rules.

Round21 v1 tracing failed with a float32/64 compatibility error; its missing validation is an execution failure, distinct from successful adverse magnitude results. Schema2 executes, but the original offending tensor remains unidentified. Do not silently reuse the invalid tracer or infer dtype meanings from exported numeric codes.

No model files or experiment interface are exposed in this query phase. Before any later counted diagnostic, re-resolve phase permissions, diagnostic export limits and charged budget; reserve attribution, paired-seed comparisons and closed assessment. Prior memory's final reserve is a planning assumption, not a verified assessment tariff. Stop if a complete discriminating audit cannot fit; another uninstrumented repeat or architecture sweep would not resolve the present uncertainty.

Only declared seed42 repeats and aggregate validation feedback are available. Independent paired seeds, per-user predictions for cluster uncertainty, exact checkpoint identities and a frozen final comparison suite remain unavailable. No withheld evaluation is requested, and no held-out outcome may enter open research.
